summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP), introduced by Anthropic in November 2024, has rapidly become the standard way to connect AI agents to external tools, data sources, and services through a shared interface. The ecosystem has exploded to over 17,000 publicly available servers tracked across registries like mcpservers.org and glama.ai, enabling agents to move beyond text generation to real action — reading files, automating browsers, managing repos, and shipping code. For AI agents, MCP matters because it replaces brittle, bespoke integrations with a composable, reusable protocol that any compliant client (Claude, Cursor, Cline, etc.) can use.
ecosystem_note: Individual MCP servers expose a single tool or service (e.g. GitHub, Playwright), aggregators bundle hundreds of servers behind one managed endpoint with unified auth (e.g. Composio, Smithery), and gateways/proxies sit in front of servers to add routing, isolation, security, and observability (e.g. agentgateway, Cloudflare, Docker MCP).

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and GitHub Actions / CI workflows using GitHub's own identity and permission model
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans; no separate MCP fee
strengths: Uses native GitHub identity and least-privilege permissions
Gold standard for code and CI workflows
tools.best_for: Automating code, repos, PRs, and CI pipelines directly from an AI agent

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation — navigation, clicking, form filling, scraping, and end-to-end testing across Chromium/Chrome
strengths: One of the most-used servers in the community
tools.best_for: Browser automation and web-based agent tasks

tools.name: Context7
tools.connects_to: Up-to-date library documentation and code examples piped directly into the model context
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; higher-volume API usage via Upstash paid plans
strengths: Eliminates hallucinated APIs with real, current docs
Trivial to add to any stack
tools.best_for: Giving coding agents accurate, version-correct documentation and API references

tools.name: Filesystem MCP
tools.connects_to: Scoped local file access — reading, writing, and editing files within allowed directories
strengths: Official reference server almost every stack starts with
tools.best_for: Local file read/write access for coding and document agents

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 250+ integrations (GitHub, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Linear, etc.) behind a single managed gateway with managed OAuth
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based and team plans beyond the free tier
strengths: Managed OAuth removes per-server auth burden
tools.best_for: Teams wanting one managed endpoint with authenticated access to many SaaS tools

tools.name: Fetch MCP
tools.connects_to: Fetching and converting web page content into model-readable text for retrieval
strengths: Core reference server bundled with the official set
tools.best_for: Letting agents pull and read live web content

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: A searchable registry and hosting platform for thousands of MCP servers with one-click deploy and configuration
tools.best_for: Discovering, installing, and hosting MCP servers quickly

tools.name: Supabase MCP
tools.connects_to: Supabase Postgres databases, auth, storage, and edge functions — letting agents query and ship backend features
tools.pricing_paid: Supabase paid plans for scaled projects
strengths: Enables agents to build and ship, not just edit
Full backend access from one server
tools.best_for: Agents that need to build and deploy real backend-backed apps

tools.name: Docker MCP Catalog & Toolkit
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers with built-in isolation, plus a gateway to run and manage them securely
tools.pricing_paid: Docker Business/Team plans for org features
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers securely with container-level isolation

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: A large public directory of MCP servers for discovery, with previews and metadata across thousands of entries
tools.best_for: Browsing and discovering the broad MCP server ecosystem

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Remote MCP server hosting on Workers, with OAuth, auth, and edge deployment for production agents
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans based on usage
tools.best_for: Deploying remote, authenticated MCP servers at the edge

tools.name: n8n MCP
tools.connects_to: n8n workflow automation — triggering and running multi-step automations across 400+ app integrations from an agent
tools.pricing_paid: Cloud plans and self-hosted enterprise tiers
strengths: Bridges agents to a mature workflow engine
Access to hundreds of app nodes
tools.best_for: Connecting agents to complex multi-step workflow automations

tools.name: Figma MCP
tools.connects_to: Figma design files — reading frames, components, and design context to generate or implement UI from designs
strengths: Pulls real design data into agents
tools.best_for: Turning Figma designs into code with design-accurate context
